articles.title: Crypto card startups are racking up losses just to buy your loyalty with big rewards
articles.snippet: Providers are betting trading, lending and staking revenue can cover rewards and turn card users into profitable customers.

articles.title: Crypto PACs made big Republican push in final weeks before November 3 election
articles.snippet: Even as polling and online wagers put Democrats at a high chance to claim greater power in Congress, the industry's high-profile support has gone the other direction.

articles.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
articles.snippet: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.

articles.title: Bitcoin held up better than expected after Binance hack, Strive CEO says
articles.snippet: Strive CEO Matt Cole says the Binance hack has not changed his long-term case for Bitcoin, but cautions it is too early to call a market bottom.

articles.title: Bitcoin turns 18: Has the original rebel grown up?
articles.snippet: In typical Bitcoin style, the number one cryptocurrency turns 18 today, amid AI-driven security threats, quantum fears and the biggest exchange hack in crypto history.
